def transform(grid):
    # Preserve the two horizontal red bars and connect their endpoints vertically.
    # The bar lengths mark a line: translate the short bar down to the long bar's row,
    # producing a red rectangle-like trace between corresponding ends.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    red_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 9 in row]
    if len(red_rows) >= 2:
        top, bottom = red_rows[0], red_rows[-1]
        left_top = min(c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v == 9)
        right_top = max(c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v == 9)
        left_bottom = min(c for c,v in enumerate(grid[bottom]) if v == 9)
        right_bottom = max(c for c,v in enumerate(grid[bottom]) if v == 9)
        # Fill interpolated diagonal traces from the shorter segment to the full-width segment.
        span = bottom - top
        for i in range(1, span):
            r = top + i
            for c in range(round(left_top + (left_bottom-left_top)*i/span), round(right_top + (right_bottom-right_top)*i/span)+1):
                out[r][c] = 9
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # For each row with a foreground run followed only by background, continue
    # its visual tail in color 1; fully filled rows stay unchanged.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in colors}
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    fg = next(v for v in colors if v != bg)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == fg]
        if positions and max(positions) < len(row) - 1 and all(value == bg for value in row[max(positions) + 1:]):
            for c in range(max(positions) + 1, len(row)):
